basic_info.description: This rarely available 2BD/2BA residence w Built-In Office nook at The Beacon offers stunning views of Twin Peaks. Upon entering, you'll be welcomed by bamboo flooring & custom molding that enhance the spacious living area, flooded w natural light from expansive windows. The open kitchen, featuring granite countertops & modern SS appliances, seamlessly connects to the living space, making it ideal for entertaining. With a desirable split floor plan, both master & guest bedrooms boast generous walk-in closets, while the primary suite includes a private en-suite bath for added comfort. Dedicated office nook caters perfectly to modern lifestyles, providing an ideal workspace. Add'l feat. are in-unit washer/dryer & secure parking space. Exceptional 5-star amenities; 24/7 doorman/security, heated outdoor pool, fitness center, sauna, newly designed clubhouse w kitchen, business ctr/conference rm, beautifully landscaped grounds & dog park. Located in the sought-after Mission Bay, this property provides direct access to Safeway and is just steps away frm Embarcadero Waterfront, Ferry Building, Oracle Park, Chase Center, Michelin-starred dining, fitness studios, and excellent public transportation options, including Caltrain, Muni, subway, T-Line & EZ freeway access to East Bay/Peninsula
